Barbie - Ocean Discovery.name: Barbie: Ocean Discovery
Barbie - Ocean Discovery.summary:
The Game Boy Color version of Adventures with Barbie: Ocean Discovery.
The PC and GBC versions are slightly different; The dolphin plays a more significant role in Windows than it does in the Game Boy Color version.

Chessmaster.name: Chessmaster
Chessmaster.summary: This portable version of the game comes with 16 different skill levels along with multiple features incorporated including color and sprite choices for the board and pieces, a teaching mode, move automations, customizable game rules, a clock, chess board orientations, a move counter, and chess piece coordinates.

Karate Joe.name: Karate Joe
Karate Joe.summary: There's a new boss in town, and his gangs are taking over the city. He's got thugs on every corner waiting to take you out. But you're not a run-of-the-mill videogame character. You're Karate Joe, and you're going to fight your way through 18 levels to free the city in this side-scrolling action-adventure.

Super Impostor Bros..name: Super Impostor Bros.
Super Impostor Bros..summary: Super Impostor Bros. is an Among Us fangame made for the GameBoy Color.
